name: s3-future-analysts-fabric
label: EXAMPLE · AI STAND-IN VOICE · NO FACE

lines.say: Future data analysts will be using Microsoft Fabric.
Not because it's new. Because of three things.
lines.title: REASONS

lines.say: One: one copy of the data. Every tool reads the same lake, so nobody's arguing about whose numbers are right.
Two: one capacity. It pays the compute for pipelines, SQL, Spark and Power BI.
lines.title: ONE CAPACITY
lines.sub: compute for pipelines · SQL · Spark · Power BI

lines.say: Three: AI built in. Data agents answer questions in plain English, on top of the models you already built.
Which means the analyst who understands the whole flow gets the job, not just the one who builds charts.
lines.show: The analyst who knows *the whole flow* gets the job.

lines.say: So learn SQL, keep Power BI, and add one thing: the lakehouse.
That's the DP-600 exam, and it's the skill set most Fabric job posts I've seen list.
lines.show: That's *DP-600*: the skill set most Fabric job posts list.
lines.tts: That's the D P six hundred exam, and it's the skill set most Fabric job posts I've seen list.

lines.say: Follow for one Fabric skill a day.
